existingRuntimeRequirements: Run identity and run directory state already owned by runtime/kernel (run-id, runtime-context)
externalSpecRequirements: Master spec (external, non-normative input) §4.2 field inventory: task reference, phase/status, active goal/plan, steps, blockers, questions, verification status, retry/replan counts, context generation, checkpoint reference
ownerDisposition: P1 contract only; lifecycle state vocabulary and enforcement arrive with P2
domain_state_ref is opaque and must never be merged with a domain workflow instance (runtime ownership matrix)
P8 contract alignment: lifecycle_state enum encodes the closed 14-state vocabulary the kernel state machine has enforced since P2; describes enforced reality, invents no new states
newInference: verification_status 'passed' requires latest_verification_ref (fail-closed against status inflation)

title: CLG RuntimeState
description: Generic runtime state envelope for a single task execution. Agent runtime state is not business workflow state: domain_state_ref is an opaque reference the generic runtime must not interpret. lifecycle_state was a free string in P1 and is, since CLG-P8 contract alignment, the closed vocabulary enforced by the canonical CLG workflow state machine (unspecified transitions are DENY).
